title: refactor: facade ObjectRepository and ScopedContext in engine.ts with the same codemod (about 700 lines), as the ObjectQL class already is
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: the maintainer asked for this on PR #30012 at 2026-11-04T10:03Z (「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」). The facades are merged: engine.ts as 237f5137 (#30012) and protocol.ts as 48914fdc (#29998). Estimates come from the #29986 / #29985 dev reports. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (devx or server).

Business reason: #30012 facaded only the `ObjectQL` class. `ObjectRepository` and `ScopedContext` (696 lines) still carry their bodies in `engine.ts`. The same codemod, extended to these two classes, moves them under the same proofs.
Reader who acts: the owner of `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`.

## What to do
- Extend the codemod to the two classes, then regenerate and prove: byte-identity, determinism, public `.d.ts` EQUAL, and suites at base counts.
- Add any by-path reader the move breaks to the PR, as #30012 did (federated READERS, core CALLERS, the census register).
- The #30019 gate rows for any exceptions go in the same PR.
Dedupe: `ObjectRepository facade`, `ScopedContext split`. **New.**
